_note:
Slots for [brg_careers-positions]. Declared beside the fragment so a slot and its {token} ship in one commit. Generated into website/acf/ by `python3 kit/build-acf.py`; never hand-edit an acf.json. Slot names are underscore-only. `text`/`textarea` defaults are esc_html'd on fill, so write literal characters — a literal `&` and a literal `—`, never `&` or `—`, which double-escape into visible entity text.\n\nThe

IS wired: it is a CTA-band heading, not a hero display headline, and it carries no structural
and no inline markup — same shape as team-apply's, which Conti approved. The surfer cutout bleeding off the right edge is decorative and stays as code.

heading.label: Heading
heading.doc: Display face on the yellow band, up to ~3.5rem. Wraps freely. ~30 characters keeps it to two lines.

sub.label: Sub copy
sub.doc: One line beneath the heading. Plain text; markup is escaped. Write `&` and `—` as literal characters.
sub.default: Browse our open roles below — from front-of-house to leadership positions across Board & Brew and Odie's Pizza Co.

cta_label.label: Button label
cta_label.doc: Black button on the yellow band. ~18 characters.

cta_href.label: Button link
cta_href.doc: Defaults to the in-page anchor for the roles list.

photo.label: Photo
photo.doc: The cut-out figure beside the open positions. A PNG with a transparent background keeps the cut-out effect; a normal photo will show its rectangle. Around 578x709. Leave empty to keep the current picture.

photo_tone.label: Photo — color
photo_tone.doc: Color is the default. Switch this photo to black and white when you want it that way on purpose — the photography on this site was only ever gray because the placeholder images were. Affects this photo alone.

photo_px.label: Photo — movement
photo_px.doc: How far this photo drifts inside its frame as you scroll. The photo is laid out taller than its frame and slides within it, so an edge never appears and it is never zoomed.

photo_px_dir.label: Photo — movement direction
photo_px_dir.doc: Which way this photo travels as the page scrolls. Neighboring photos set in opposite directions are what reads as depth.

photo_float.label: Photo — frame drift
photo_float.doc: Moves the whole frame across the section, on top of the movement inside it. Leave off for a photo that fills its section edge to edge — there is nothing behind it to reveal.

photo_float_dir.label: Photo — drift direction
photo_float_dir.doc: Which way this frame drifts. Set a large and a small photo in opposite directions.
